name: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering Limited
summary: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides electrical, instrumentation, communications, security, fire, and maintenance services and products in Australia. The company operates through SCEE Electrical, Heyday, Trivantage, and Force Fire segments.
